basis: Revenue $52.4m 'on plan', but free cash flow turned positive, cash rose $76m q/q, non-GAAP op loss narrowed 33% q/q and bookings rose 73% q/q, evidence that the turnaround is working; Q2 guide of $51-55m is flat, so the positive rests on cash and losses rather than growth. For a heavily shorted, high-volatility name that is a meaningful up move.
